name: my_body
description: Her own body map: every bone, finger joint and face shape she has, what each does, how left/right work for her (her left = right of your screen), and the body measurements her self-check scores. Live questions (what's your left hand doing, how close was your pose) are answered by the site from her real measured body; this answers from her body map when the live body isn't sent.

example.text: what body parts do you have?
